title: OMNIS+: Semantic RAN Slicing and Quantization for Dynamic Split Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.23977v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Edge computing enables resource-constrained devices to execute machine learning (ML) applications via task offloading, with radio access network (RAN) slicing playing a crucial role in provisioning joint communication and computing resources. However, existing RAN slicing frameworks rely on static computing models, limiting their ability to exploit dynamic semantic data representations enabled by modern neural architectures. To address this limitation, we propose OMNIS+, a semantic RAN slicing framework for multi-cell edge computing built upon a new generation of dynamic split neural models. OMNIS+ incorporates dynamic neural compression paired with adaptive quantization for task offloading, providing a versatile decision space across communication payload and compute dimensions. We leveraged a novel ``box'' quantization scheme that markedly enhances resilience to transmission bit errors across diverse compression rates. Considering part

translated_title: OMNIS+：面向动态分割神经网络的语义RAN切片与量化
translated_abstract: 边缘计算使资源受限的设备能够通过任务卸载来执行机器学习（ML）应用，其中无线接入网（RAN）切片在联合配置通信与计算资源方面发挥着关键作用。然而，现有的RAN切片框架依赖于静态计算模型，限制了其利用现代神经架构所支持的动态语义数据表示的能力。为解决这一局限，我们提出了OMNIS+，一个基于新一代动态分割神经模型的多小区边缘计算语义RAN切片框架。OMNIS+将动态神经压缩与自适应量化相结合用于任务卸载，在通信负载和计算维度上提供了灵活多样的决策空间。我们采用了一种新颖的“box”量化方案，该方案在不同压缩率下显著增强了对传输比特错误的鲁棒性。考虑到部分（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了OMNIS+语义RAN切片框架，通过动态分割神经网络、语义压缩与自适应“box”量化，在多小区边缘计算中实现通信与计算资源的联合优化调度，并显著增强了对传输比特错误的鲁棒性。
